mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM auth_user_role ur INNER JOIN auth_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM auth_user_role ur INNER JOIN auth_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN auth_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.perm_status = 'ACTIVE'
